shared_contract: All modes use approved current transformed triangle terrain and the same audio presentation clock.

modes.topology: Approved displaced point grid and emitter fronts
modes.distinctive_behaviour: White pulse scale/emission with stable masked rows and the existing large crests.
modes.entry: Preserve sample-zero white opening and black sky.
modes.exit: Crossfade a stable mask, preserving physical waves.
modes.palette_policy: white or restrained final held pair

modes.topology: Segmented contour ribbons / narrow luminous dashes over exact triangle surface
modes.distinctive_behaviour: Alternating contour bands ripple with bass; deliberate missing segments create negative space.
modes.entry: Fade most ordinary points while ribbon segments rise in brightness; no geometry popping.
modes.exit: Reduce ribbon emission before changing topology.
modes.palette_policy: cool held palette after entry; light moves, base hues can hold

modes.topology: Shared smooth opaque 3D spheres in staggered groups over the wave terrain
modes.distinctive_behaviour: A/B groups swell and exchange localized gradient/emission states; silhouettes have volume.
modes.entry: Small spheres appear from dark groups while underlying points dim.
modes.exit: Shrink/fade groups smoothly; do not delete on a frame boundary.
modes.palette_policy: white/cyan/blue gradient held; local accents alternate stable groups

modes.topology: Real moving point targets plus masked field groups
modes.distinctive_behaviour: Dots form circle, diamond and chevron; localized coral/cyan or lime/violet pairs swap at selected accents without a global brightness flash.
modes.entry: Stable slot assignment and eased actual position morph.
modes.exit: Dissolve targets toward field anchors and fade before optical mode.
modes.palette_policy: section-led paired hue changes; bounded transitions, not permanent global rainbow

modes.topology: Sparse smooth 3D lens/gel volumes with actual transmission/refraction
modes.distinctive_behaviour: Underlying lights refract through readable curved volumes; shape swells gently with the mid-band envelope.
modes.entry: Fade busy shapes down, then reveal a few optical heroes with useful reflection lighting.
modes.exit: Remove glass optical weight before dense air-bubble groups appear.
modes.palette_policy: held warm reflection environment; minor localized edge hue shifts

modes.topology: The same bounded morph pool with original icons then monoline UP
modes.distinctive_behaviour: One short planned pullback gives silhouettes room; return to low frame with strong group breathing.
modes.entry: Single camera owner lifts smoothly; surrounding field density falls.
modes.exit: UP dissolves/low camera returns smoothly on the reviewed return phrase.
modes.palette_policy: white/cyan on a dark sky; no copied avatars/branding

modes.topology: Sparse volumetric sphere groups with varied radii in near/mid/far layers
modes.distinctive_behaviour: Alternating groups swell/lift gently on selected musical accents; world-space clearances prevent hill penetration.
modes.entry: Return from overview; introduce a few nearby volumes and deeper small spheres.
modes.exit: Fade near cluster before beam passage becomes dominant.
modes.palette_policy: localized blue/violet/teal gradients; some groups remain dark

modes.topology: Four to six soft sky beams and restrained localized light pools rooted at emitter regions
modes.distinctive_behaviour: Phrase-led beam aim changes with bounded on-beat pulse; sky gets a held coloured horizon.
modes.entry: Beams arrive in pairs with soft angular falloff; no stage/architecture props.
modes.exit: Lose beam intensity gradually; return emphasis to waves through the genuine end.
modes.palette_policy: paired magenta/amber and cyan light, dark zenith held
